title: docs(idd): point idd-resume.instructions.md's §W1-§W8 pointer at §FH too
body:
## Background

`.github/instructions/idd-resume.instructions.md`'s Step 1 table
(around line 103) cites "Forced-handoff recovery confirmed (§FH)", and
a real `## §FH — Forced-Handoff Recovery` detail entry exists in
`docs/idd-resume-detail.md` (line 8). But unlike its siblings §W1-§W8,
the file's own pointer sentence (around line 148 — "Section numbers
§W1-§W8 are detail entries in `docs/idd-resume-detail.md`") never
mentions §FH, so nothing in-scope tells a cold reader where §FH is
actually defined, even though the abbreviation itself is glossed
inline as "Forced-handoff recovery" in the table.

Surfaced by the completion audit of roadmap #1598 (`idd-spec-audit` dry
run, #1597 / PR #1610).

## Proposed change

Update the pointer sentence around line 148 to include §FH alongside
§W1-§W8, for example: "Section numbers §W1-§W8 and §FH are detail
entries in `docs/idd-resume-detail.md`."

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The pointer sentence in `idd-resume.instructions.md` names §FH
      alongside §W1-§W8 as a `docs/idd-resume-detail.md` detail entry.
- [ ] `node scripts/audit-docs.mjs --check` passes.

---
